name: Read native Tier 1 Government Plaza production gates after Oligarchy

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local d=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.Tier1ProductionDiagnosis(); assert(d.owner==0 and d.turn==25 and d.governmentType=='GOVERNMENT_OLIGARCHY' and d.governmentTier=='Tier1' and d.coreTitleTotal==1 and d.coreTitleSpent==0 and d.cityID==65536 and d.districtID==458758 and d.districtPlot==5437 and #d.candidates==3,'saved Government, Plaza, or title proof differs'); return d.status..' plan='..d.planStage..' policy='..d.policy.status..' open='..tostring(d.policy.openCount)..' cost='..tostring(d.policy.unlockCost)..' tall='..tostring(d.candidates[1].allowed)..'/'..d.candidates[1].allowedResults.kind
